rows.name: loading?
rows.notes: Busy: activation is refused, the label keeps its width and `aria-busy` says so.

rows.name: loadingText?
rows.notes: Announced politely when `loading` turns on. Without it nothing is announced — a spinner appearing is not news a screen reader has to interrupt for.

rows.name: focusableWhenDisabled?
rows.notes: Keeps the control focusable while disabled: `aria-disabled` instead of the native attribute. Off by default — a disabled button has no reason to stay in the tab order unless it is a toolbar item (APG).

rows.name: nativeButton?
rows.notes: False when the root is not a real `<button>` (a substituted `<div>`, a card). The adapter sets it from what it renders; it decides who activates the control — the browser's click, or the press primitive's synthesised keyboard.

rows.name: children?
rows.notes: The label. Text, and text is the only thing that names a button.

rows.name: icon?
rows.notes: The leading glyph — an inline SVG, never a text character.

rows.name: accessory?
rows.notes: The trailing one: a chevron, a shortcut, a count.
